title: Settings
subtitle: System-wide options for the authority, reminders, attendance and printing.
age_groups_note: Age groups for placing students in circles are managed with the circles.

logo.title: Logo
logo.help: PNG, JPEG or WebP, square, up to 2 MB. Shown on the login and registration pages.

authority.title: Authority
authority.desc: Name, address and contact shown on pages, messages and printouts.

locale.title: Language and region
locale.desc: Time zone, phone country code, dates and the default language.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.desc: When WhatsApp reminders go out for lessons, invoices, exams and the weekly report.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.desc: When repeated absence raises an alert on the dashboard.

sessions.title: Lesson sessions
sessions.desc: How far ahead lesson sessions are generated.

progress.title: Memorization and evaluation
progress.desc: Memorization direction, the difficulty threshold and monthly progress messages.

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.desc: Approval, family notification and automatic juz certificates.

ui.title: Appearance
ui.desc: How much Islamic ornament the screens show.

media.title: Photos and printing
media.desc: Gender separation rules for printed photos.

honor.title: Honor board
honor.desc: Ranking weights, full-attendance rule and the TV display.

locale.timezone.label: Time zone
locale.timezone.help: Used for lesson times, reminders and reports.

locale.country_code.label: Phone country code
locale.country_code.help: Digits only, added to local numbers (973 for Bahrain).

locale.currency.label: Currency
locale.currency.help: Amounts are stored in fils, so the currency cannot be changed.

locale.show_hijri.label: Show Hijri date
locale.show_hijri.help: Next to the Gregorian date on screens and certificates.

locale.default.label: Default language
locale.default.help: For new users and the public pages.

reminders.pre_lesson_hours.label: Lesson reminder
reminders.pre_lesson_hours.help: How long before a lesson the reminder is sent.

reminders.invoice_days_before.label: Invoice reminder before the due date

reminders.invoice_days_after.label: Overdue invoice reminder
reminders.invoice_days_after.help: Days after the due date. 0 turns it off.

reminders.weekly_report_day.label: Weekly report day
reminders.weekly_report_day.help: The weekly summary goes to admins on this day.

registration.open.label: Registration open
registration.open.help: When off, the public form says registration is closed.

registration.photo_required.label: Student photo required
registration.photo_required.help: Applies to the public form, quick enrollment and accepting requests.

sessions.generate_weeks_ahead.label: Generate sessions ahead
sessions.generate_weeks_ahead.help: Sessions are created this far ahead of today.

progress.default_direction.label: Default memorization direction
progress.default_direction.help: For packages that do not set their own.

evaluation.issue_threshold.label: Difficulty threshold
evaluation.issue_threshold.help: A score below this suggests recording a difficulty.

messages.progress_update_enabled.label: Monthly progress message
messages.progress_update_enabled.help: Sends each family a progress summary on WhatsApp.

messages.progress_update_day.label: Day of the month
messages.progress_update_day.help: The day the monthly progress message is sent.

certificates.require_approval.label: Certificates need approval
certificates.require_approval.help: Drafts are hidden from families until approved.

certificates.notify_on_approve.label: Notify the family on approval
certificates.notify_on_approve.help: Sends a congratulation message on WhatsApp.

certificates.auto_juz.label: Draft a certificate for each completed juz

ui.ornament_level.label: Ornament level
ui.ornament_level.help: Minimal keeps borders and headings; off removes the patterns.

media.print_female_photos.label: Print girls’ photos
media.print_female_photos.help: When off, girls’ photos never appear on printed rosters or certificates.

honor.weight_attendance.label: Attendance weight
honor.weight_attendance.help: Share of the monthly score from attendance. The three weights are scaled to 100.

honor.full_attendance_min_sessions.label: Minimum sessions for full attendance
honor.full_attendance_min_sessions.help: A student needs at least this many sessions in the month to count as fully attending.

honor.display_key.label: Display screen key
honor.display_key.help: Letters, digits, - and _ only. Leave empty to turn the TV display off.
